review_kind: Assistant release-engineering review of the owner-accepted scope, retained counterexamples and source-bound technical receipts
scope_policy: Original definitions, priorities, receipts and owner responses remain unchanged. Final technical gates discharge the accepted publication condition; they do not create another owner response or independent validation.

reviewed_risks.risk: Identity collapse by equal labels or aliases
Occurrence or governed case invented from documentary content
Issued payload or dependency history overwritten
Incompatible selected scales/versions accepted for direct comparison
Forged or misjoined provenance; correction treated as corroboration
Model, ORSD, article or schema versions drift
Unaccepted original MUST capability silently claimed
Wrong source, missing checks or overwritten release assets
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: tests/test_stable_release.py plus independent final downloaded readback

limit: No known critical retained-scope defect was identified in this bounded screen; unknown/domain-wide defects are not ruled out. Any failed retained-task or integrity check blocks publication. Historical HermiT NOT_RUN and SHACL NOT_RUN/PARTIAL rows retain their original status.
